entities.summary: Marek Forgáč is Slovak bishop who has been the titular bishop of Seleuciana and the auxiliary bishop of Archdiocese of Košice since 2016. In years 2011 — 2016, he served as Pro Dean of the Faculty of Theology of the Catholic University in Košice.
